lang_hint: Picked from your phone settings. You can change it any time.
welcome_say: Start Korean from the alphabet with Dubu, Kong and the teacher at Gyeongbokgung Palace.
no_explain: No explanation for this line yet.
loop_hint: Tap a letter above to hear it on repeat.
writing_preparing_desc: This line has no writing practice yet.
speak_hint: Listen to the model, then press Speak and say it.
speak_hint_noscore: This browser can't give a score (Chrome recommended). You can still record and compare.
no_score: Recorded. Listen and compare with the model.
score_try: Try once more, or move on.
mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser (lock icon next to the address).
mic_busy: The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it, or it was unplugged. Tap 🎤 to choose another one.
mic_silent: No sound is coming in. Choose another microphone below.
mic_switched: That microphone was silent, so I switched to another one. Speak now.
score_5: Perfect! You sound just like the model.
score_2: Not quite yet. Listen to the model again, then try.
score_1: Let's try again slowly. Listen to the model first.
help_sp_1: ▶ Model — listen to the model. Tap "Speed" to hear it slower (0.9 · 0.75 · 0.6 · 0.5×).
help_sp_2: ● Speak — say it after the model. It stops by itself when you finish.
help_sp_3: ▶ My voice — hear your recording, played without the noise before and after.
help_sp_4: Score = letters × rhythm. You get 100 only when every letter is right and your rhythm matches the model over 85%. 80% or more passes (☆, you can save it); 95% or more gets ★.
help_sp_5: Compare — the model's and your waveforms, top and bottom. Red letter: heard differently. Orange border: where the rhythm differs most. Tap the waveform to play from there.
v9_other: Hear it in the other language
v9_mode_LL: Listen and read in your language — start here
v9_mode_kL: Listen in Korean, check in your language — cross
v9_mode_Lk: Listen in your language, read in Korean — cross
v9_mode_kk: Korean only — like a Korean-Korean dictionary
sr_none: I couldn't hear that clearly — please say it again.
sr_audio: Speech recognition couldn't use the microphone. Choose another microphone (🎤).
sr_network: An internet connection is needed for scoring.
sr_denied: Speech recognition is blocked. Allow the microphone in the browser.
kept_better: Your saved one scored higher — kept it.
del_all: Delete all my recordings in this episode
del_all_q: Delete all your recordings in this episode?
ep_missing: That lesson wasn't found — here is the list.
why_time: ⏱ Time's up — speak a little faster
mode_full_d: hear a line, then its explanation
mode_explain_d: hear only the explanations in a row
mode_full_go: Line+Explain — a line, then its explanation
mode_explain_go: Explain only — explanations in a row
w_tip: Tap a letter — you hear it
why_tail: The end wasn’t heard: {tail} — say it all the way through
why_other: It sounded like something else — listen to the model {say} and repeat it
why_many: {ws} and more are different — listen to the model and try again
cmp_none: Nothing to compare yet — record first.
rhy_speed: speed is very different from the model
help_sp_6: Only passing takes are kept (a higher score replaces it). Recordings stay in this browser and are deleted with the site data. Tap ⬇ to save a file.
help_wr_1: ⌨ Keyboard / ✍ Handwriting — choose how to write.
help_wr_2: Top letter row — tap a letter to start writing from there. Filled letter: the one to write now. Green: already written.
help_wr_3: Keyboard — press the consonants and vowels in order. The part you typed fills in dark over the faint letter. There are also "Listen to this part" and "Auto-complete" buttons.
help_wr_4: Handwriting — trace over the faint letter. Choose ✏️ Pencil, 🖊 Pen or 🖌 Brush. When you finish, press ✓ or lift your finger/mouse for a moment — your score appears.
help_wr_5: Score — based on how much of the faint letter you covered and how much went outside it. 80% or more ☆, 95% or more ★.
help_wr_6: Order — shows the stroke order and direction. It tells you if your order is wrong.
why_pause_tail: You paused too long — keep going a bit faster to the end
sr_only_note: letter score only on this phone
sr_only_why: This phone can't record and recognise speech at the same time, so only the letter score is given — no rhythm, compare or my voice.
sr_only_switched: This phone can't record and recognise speech together — from now on only speech recognition is used for the score. Please say it again.
sr_both_set: Next time recording and speech recognition will be tried together again.
why_late: Accurate, but much too slow — read along as the colour fills in
